## Behavior

Describe the concrete user problem and resulting behavior. Include milestone/requirement IDs and any prerequisite PR.

## Validation

List checks actually run and relevant failure/recovery cases. Include screenshots for UI changes and deployment/restore evidence when affected.

## Contracts and remaining work

Record migrations/configuration, access/encryption implications and remaining mocks or device/production qualification. Update `docs/plan/requirements-coverage.md` when a requirement's implementation status changes.
